title: Pager rollback-journal page checksum

scope.rationale: pager_cksum computes the rollback-journal record checksum from cksumInit and every reverse-stride 200th byte selected from one page.
excluded_responsibilities: Journal checksum-seed generation and header storage

external_source_responsibilities: Journal append and playback provide a complete page-sized image
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete checksum helper and both generated blocks are assigned; production journal append and playback consume the exact helper.

inputs: Borrowed Pager checksum seed and page size
Borrowed page image at least page-size bytes long
contracts.ownership: Pure borrowed observation; no allocation or transfer.
contracts.state_and_results: Initialize from the current seed, start at page_size-200, add the selected unsigned byte while the signed index is positive, and decrement by 200. Byte zero is deliberately excluded.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Infallible for a complete page image; debug assertion rejects undersized internal input.

representation_differences: Zig accepts a bounded slice and asserts its minimum page-size length instead of a raw page pointer.
The source int loop index is represented as isize while preserving the positive-index stop condition.

oracle.protocol: Use a 512-byte page, seed max-u32-3, set selected offsets 312 and 112 plus excluded offset 0, and require wrapping result 8. Production malformed-journal and append/playback tests exercise both consumers.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; journal owners synchronize externally.
assurance.malformed_input: Internal slice length assertion prevents out-of-bounds access.
assurance.continuation: Pure computation preserves Pager and page state.
assurance.performance: Linear in page_size/200 with no allocation.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig rollback journal append and playback
integration.native_call_path: appendJournalRecord serializes journalChecksum; playbackJournal recomputes it before restoring a page.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: The checksum is no longer folded into append-only ownership; both writer and reader share the source-shaped helper.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C isolated trace, broader page-size matrix, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C isolated checksum vectors across supported page sizes.
Promote complete append/playback journal unit evidence.
